description: Impianti di depurazione biologici is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices1.civis.bz.it. Impianti di depurazione delle acque reflue urbane. Coverage: IT. Its keywords include Kanalisation, Sonderbauwerk, Impianto di depurazione, Pumpstation, Kläranlage, Stazione di pompaggio. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
